calls.prompt:
This is a small exploratory Island memory-carryover pilot. This is a fictional coordination case. Do not use outside research. Keep documented history, case facts, and your recommendations distinct. Treat recommendations as recommendations, not as historical evidence.

Evidence packet C — “crystal” claims with source pointers and limits:
- C1 (documented): BAMF's main page calls its approach “Structureless” Structure, records group consensus, and says elected leadership was planned but there was “No pressing need at the moment.” [BAMF oldid 405670]
- C2 (documented complication): an early incarnation failed; the technical lead accepts responsibility and requests a postmortem. The archive also documents a Dev Steering Board with three voting developers plus an alternate, group consensus for direction, and formal elected leadership deferred while mentoring/teaching were prioritized. [BAMF/Archive oldid 405267]
- C3 (documented): people unable to attend may have their concerns represented by a proxy; inclusiveness is named as a basic tenet. [BAMF/Pi oldid 329877]
- C4 (documented): the FAQ welcomes nontechnical participants. [BAMF/FAQ]
- Unknown: exact membership rights, universal enforcement, private preferences, and whether any arrangement worked for every member. Do not convert one recorded practice into a timeless rule.
- Working lesson (inference, not a source quotation): retain participation, explicit responsibility, and room for useful structure; let current people choose the arrangement that fits the case.

Case: An experienced maintainer requests a narrow technical decision lane so work can move. New participants still need genuine influence and learning opportunities. Recommend a process.

Return concise JSON with exactly these keys: historical_claims (array; cite only packet source IDs/pages), unknowns (array), recommendation (2–4 actionable steps), human_choices (at least two real options where appropriate, including who decides), confidence (integer 0–100 plus a one-sentence reason), and overreach_risk (one likely way this response could distort the history). Do not present the fictional case as a real event.
